title: Video production and new forms of circulation
description: As the historic cinema-hall network declined, fiction made and circulated on video became increasingly important. Filmada's earlier chronology records works including Adim-piainana, Makibefo and the popular Malok'ila series, alongside temporary reopening of the Ritz and Rex for Cannes Junior and the creation of new video-production companies.

sources.note: Recovered from Filmada's earlier cinema chronology; further research should document production, distribution and audiences during the video era.
